plans.idea: Classic three-column banner read left to right: a smaller badge gets breathing room, the headline and subline take a larger centre column so they lead, and the CTA sits on the right, centred on the text block.
Text first: the headline and subline sit large on the left with the CTA directly beneath them as one group, and the badge closes the right end as the brand sign-off.
Brand-anchored stack: the badge sits on the left, and a wide text column filling the rest of the banner carries an oversized headline with the subline and CTA aligned under it on one left edge.
